Interface ControllerInterface

All Known Implementing Classes:
Controller
public interface ControllerInterface
Interface defining the methods that a player can invoke to interact with the game server. This includes login, game creation/joining, in-game actions, and state updates.

  • Method Details

    • login

      void login(String nickname) throws Exception
      Verifies that the chosen nickname is unique and binds the player's view to the controller. If the nickname is already taken, a message is sent to the player. If the nickname belongs to a disconnected player, reconnects them.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player's chosen name
      Throws:
      Exception - if the login process fails

    • createGame

      void createGame(String gameName, int playerCount, GameMode mode) throws Exception
      Creates a new game session with the specified name, player count, and game mode. Notifies the player if the game name is already in use.
      Parameters:
      gameName - name of the new game lobby
      playerCount - maximum number of players
      mode - the selected GameMode
      Throws:
      Exception - if creation fails or name is already taken

    • joinGame

      void joinGame(String gameName) throws Exception
      Attempts to join an existing game lobby by name. If the lobby is full after joining, the game starts. Notifies the player if the lobby doesn't exist.
      Parameters:
      gameName - the name of the game lobby to join
      Throws:
      Exception - if the lobby cannot be joined

    • leaveGame

      void leaveGame() throws Exception
      Allows the player to leave the current game during the lobby phase. Updates their view to the list of available lobbies.
      Throws:
      Exception - if leaving the game fails
